notes: Intro: Synaptic Pulse runs personalized commerce assistants for 40+ retailers; high-concurrency real-time chat under checkout flows.
Primary constraint: p95 end-to-end from request arrival to token send must be <= 120ms for short prompts (<= 128 tokens). If p95 > 180ms conversion drops noticeably per their A/B tests.
Throughput target: sustain bursts to 600 req/sec per region during peak sale windows; steady-state 150-250 req/sec.
Cost sensitivity: wants to lower per-inference cost vs current managed endpoint. Target ARR economics: reduce per-session inference cost by ~30% vs current vendor.
Model preferences: lean toward open checkpoints (Llama 2 / Llama 3 style) or quantized Mistral variant. Interested in 8-bit/4-bit quant profiles if accuracy holds for intent + slot extraction.

Batching/caching interest: strong. Willing to accept micro-batching (<20ms batching latency) and prefix-KV caching for repeat checkout flows. Wants Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching window and cache TTL.
Quantization trade-offs: must validate answer quality on reranking/slots and recommendation prompts. Wants automatic quantization suggestion but will run quality evals (their eval set attached).

Perf benchmarking ask: Redwood to run 3-tier perf sweep: baseline hosted model, dedicated quantized 8-bit, dedicated 4-bit + KV cache. Tests: p50/p95 latency, tail jitter, tokens/sec, memory footprint, CPU/GPU utilization, cost per 1M tokens.
Routing/fallback: need policy to route to cheaper compatible variant when dedicated pool saturates; must degrade gracefully (e.g., lower temperature/shorter max tokens) rather than failing.
Security/regulatory: EU customers require data residency for EU orders. SSO + SCIM provisioning required for SREs. Audit logs and KMS integration mandatory for Private option.
Quote from Head of ML: "If we can get predictable p95 and 30% cost down with no material hit to conversion, we switch."
